main_text.p: tentem, supra testudinem templi constituebant, ut intempesta nocte se animam eius esse simularet, atq; ob Lutheranismum perpetuo damnatam dice-ret. Res est tandem Lutetiam ad regium senatum delata. Ubi coram cancellario, Antonio Praten-se, Colimannus & Stephanus Atrebatensis, ambo eius sectae theologi, in maleficio deprehensi & con-victi sunt, ac de communi consilio lata sententia ad publicam ignominiam damnati. In hos impostores, Vulteius Remensis hoc edidit carmen:

Cum clamat larvas, furiosa caterva leonum, Infestare suam nocte dicq; domum: Res vera est, falsi, larvati deniq; fratres, Quos vestis sanctos prodigiosa ficit, Sunt lemures, larvae, furiae, vulpesq;, lupiq;, Qui infestant nitiys[?] sequé suamqué domum.

Nunc de Pauli tertij filio notho, Petro Aloysio, Parmae ac Placentiae duce, aliquid dicendum oc-currit: qui, quia superbia ferox & libidinosissimus tyrannus erat, anno Domini 1548 & decimo die Augusti, à suis nobilibus occidebatur. Quum hic sceleratissimus nebulo ( ut ex quibusdam Italicis li-bris, Vergerius ac Sleidanus referūt (exercitus Ro-mani primarium ducem agens, Fanum appulisset: ibiq; Cosmum Cherium, eiusdem urbis episcopum, qui tricesimum annum excesserat, summa pruden-tia,

page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout and is transcribed as s. Ligature "ct" in "nocte" is printed as a ligature and is transcribed as "cte". Italic or heavy-set type in the first paragraph (names and "sectae theologi ... con-") is uncertain, because it looks bold or underlined in the scan; the italics are my best reading. "Cosmum Cherium" is underlined in the scan. "nitiys" is a doubtful reading, possibly a printing error. The verse line "sectae"/"laruas" spelling is kept as printed, with u/v changed only where consonantal. The page ends mid-sentence ("tia,") and continues on the next page.
